subject: Nimble Health SIG follow-up: SSO / SCIM / RBAC evidence
messages:
From: Anna Sullivan <anna.sullivan@nimblehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: SSO details + provisioning evidence request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Nimble Health is excited about the latency profiles you showed. The SIG questionnaire flagged a few follow-ups on access controls that we need to validate before security review:

- SSO / SAML: request for SAML metadata and confirmation of SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated support
- SCIM: sample provisioning log and the attributes you sync (email, employeeId, title)
- RBAC: canonical list of built-in roles and guidance on creating least-privilege custom roles
- MFA: enforcement policies for admin and non-admins, and any bypass/exceptions workflow

Could you send the artifacts for those items and a short note about how you handle least-privilege role scoping? If you have a short runbook or exported metadata, that would be perfect.

Thanks — we have a security review kickoff next Friday (May 17).

Anna
Security Engineer, Nimble Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Sullivan <anna.sullivan@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: SSO details + provisioning evidence request

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear list. Attaching the items you asked for and summarizing below.

Quick summary:
- SAML: attached saml-metadata-export.xml (SP metadata). We support both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated SSO. Our default session lifetime is 8 hours; we can reduce for customer-specific sessions via configuration.
- SCIM: see scim-provisioning-runbook.pdf (includes example provisioning logs and attribute map). We provision on create/update/deactivate and send 200/404 status codes in the response body for auditability.
- RBAC: attached rbac-role-mapping-2028-05.xlsx with built-in role definitions. We recommend a base set of three roles (Viewer, Editor, Admin). Custom roles can be scoped to model routes and teams.
- MFA: platform enforces MFA for all admin-class accounts by default. Non-admin enforcement is configurable per-organization at onboarding; exceptions require an approved security justification ticket (we log every bypass attempt).

Next steps:
1) Dev/Marcus: confirm the SCIM event sample in the runbook includes the attribute names Anna called out and export the most recent 30 days of provisioning logs if possible.
2) Anna: let us know if you need additional cryptographic details or a digested audit trail.

Regards,
Marissa
Director, Customer Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: saml-metadata-export.xml (text/xml), scim-provisioning-runbook.pdf (application/pdf), rbac-role-mapping-2028-05.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 May 2028 09:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: SSO details + provisioning evidence request

Marissa — I grabbed the RBAC export and added a recommended least-privilege mapping into the spreadsheet (column: recommended_practice). Highlights:

- Viewer: read-only access to routes + logs; cannot trigger model runs or change configs. Recommended for analysts.
- Editor: can create routes and run tests but cannot modify billing or create org-level API keys. Recommended for product teams.
- Admin: full access including key management and billing. Admins require MFA + 2-person approval for org-level changes.

Also added a short section on role-scoped attributes (team, environment, model-prefix) to restrict access programmatically. I put the updated spreadsheet in the drive link (same folder Marissa sent).

Marcus
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Sullivan <anna.sullivan@nimblehealth.com>, Thomas Reed <thomas.reed@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 May 2028 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: SSO details + provisioning evidence request

Anna / Thomas — attaching the exported artifacts we discussed and a short answers doc inline below. Let me know if you want a signed attestation or additional audit logs.

Inline answers (short):
- SAML: SP + IdP supported; metadata attached. We sign assertions with RSA-SHA256. Session TTL default 8 hours; per-customer TTL available.
- SCIM: provisioning runs on create/update/deactivate; sample payload and 30-day CSV export attached. We log request/response codes and user externalId.
- RBAC: built-in roles (Viewer/Editor/Admin) included; custom roles available. Admin role requires MFA and manual approval for org-level secrets changes. Least-privilege guidance added to the spreadsheet.
- MFA: enforced for Admins at platform level; optional for non-admins and configurable during onboarding. Any bypass requires an approved ticket and is logged.

Attachments: saml-metadata-export.xml, scim-provisioning-runbook.pdf, rbac-role-mapping-2028-05.xlsx

Next actions:
- Anna: confirm receipt and whether you need us to share a short transmittal letter for your security team.
- Thomas: if you still need certificate fingerprints or a test IdP, we can stand one up in our staging tenant this week.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Customer Security Programs
Redwood Inference
